reason: The core app is free, so first I'd just let my kid use that for a few weeks and see if she actually sticks with it. And if PRO only goes through Google Play or App Store billing, my Uzcard/Humo card probably won't work there, so I wouldn't even get to the pay screen.
objection: I don't see Payme or Click anywhere. I pay Kinopoisk and Yandex Plus from my card without trouble, but store billing with a local card usually fails, and I'm not going to go looking for a Visa just for a kids' app.
would_change_my_mind: A Payme/Click payment option inside the app, plus seeing my child really learning letters on the free version before first grade.
